# 74173 - 4-bit D-type register with tri-state outputs

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74173.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74173.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 34 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74173 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74173.png) | ![74173 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74173.png) | ![74173 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74173.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 7 | CLOCK | clock |  |  | rising edge |
| 15 | CLEAR | input | high |  | acts at once (not clocked) |
| 9 | G1 | input | low |  | data enable: both G1 and G2 low loads D at the clock edge; either high holds |
| 10 | G2 | input | low |  | data enable (see G1) |
| 1 | M | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 4, 5, 6; when not enabled: float; output control; M or N high puts the outputs in the high-impedance state; the flip-flops keep working |
| 2 | N | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 4, 5, 6; when not enabled: float |
| 14 | 1D | input |  |  |  |
| 3 | 1Q | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1, 2 |
| 13 | 2D | input |  |  |  |
| 4 | 2Q | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1, 2 |
| 12 | 3D | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | 3Q | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1, 2 |
| 11 | 4D | input |  |  |  |
| 6 | 4Q | output |  | three-state | enabled by 1, 2 |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 3 | 1Q = (M' AND N') ? FF1 : Z | Shows flip-flop 1 when M and N are both low; high impedance when either is high. |
| 4 | 2Q = (M' AND N') ? FF2 : Z | Shows flip-flop 2 when M and N are both low; high impedance when either is high. |
| 5 | 3Q = (M' AND N') ? FF3 : Z | Shows flip-flop 3 when M and N are both low; high impedance when either is high. |
| 6 | 4Q = (M' AND N') ? FF4 : Z | Shows flip-flop 4 when M and N are both low; high impedance when either is high. |

## Stored state

Bits stored: 4

Changes on: rising edge of CLOCK

- CLEAR high: all four flip-flops = 0 at once
- CLEAR low, CLOCK low (no edge): hold
- CLEAR low, rising CLOCK, G1 high or G2 high: hold
- CLEAR low, rising CLOCK, G1 low and G2 low: flip-flop = D
- The output controls M and N do not affect the flip-flops

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 16 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -5.2 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Three-state outputs; off-state current +/-40 uA. Up to 128 SN74173 outputs may share a bus and still drive two standard loads. |

| CLOCK | any Q | PLH |  | 28 | 43 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| CLOCK | any Q | PHL |  | 19 | 31 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| M or N | any Q | PZH | 7 | 16 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| M or N | any Q | PZL | 7 | 21 | 30 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 50 pF |
| M or N | any Q | PHZ | 3 | 5 | 14 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 5 pF |
| M or N | any Q | PLZ | 3 | 11 | 20 | VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, RL 400 ohm, CL 5 pF |

## Not known

- The switching table does not name the input for the enable/disable times; M or N is assumed from their role (output control). Marked as an assumption.

## Notes

Edges PZH, PZL, PHZ, PLZ are output enable/disable times (three-state), not PLH/PHL. All switching figures at RL 400 ohm.
